decisions.decision: Delete the previously proposed words 'who may delegate such authority' from 3.5, 3.9 and 3.14, since Section 4.3 already lets the town manager delegate.
decisions.quote: 3.14 sewer commissioners (b) powers and duties delete the previously proposed words

decisions.decision: Remove the requirement in 3-5, 3-9 and 3.13 that the boards stay out of day to day administration, because the wording did not meet the clarifying purpose.
decisions.quote: the committee will take out the previously proposed language requiring staying out of day to day administration

decisions.decision: Delete section 8-5 as a duplicate of the first paragraph of section 8-2.
decisions.quote: this section is not needed as it is a duplicate of the first paragraph of section 8-2.

decisions.decision: Add a sentence at the end of 6-3 that the budget summary shall be mailed with the warrant to households with registered voters.
decisions.quote: the summary of the budget shall be mailed with the warrant to households with registered voters

decisions.decision: Present the controversial topics as separate articles at the spring town meeting, and seek pro and con statements for voters.
decisions.quote: these topics will be presented as separate articles at the spring town meeting.

decisions.decision: Seek pro and con statements so voters have information on both sides of each controversial proposal.
decisions.quote: we will seek to have pro and con statements so that the voters will have information on both sides of the proposal.

decisions.decision: Bob Ebersole will talk with Town Counsel about a standing second town meeting that is not confused with annual town meeting and does not require special town meeting standards.
decisions.quote: bob will talk with town counsel about how to meet the desire to have a standing second town meeting

decisions.decision: Move the proposed language on appointment of the land use director to the Town Manager section (3-10).
decisions.quote: move the proposed language regarding appointment of the land use director to the town manager section.

decisions.decision: Clarify that the residency requirement in 4-2(c) applies only to an appointed town clerk due to election requirements.
decisions.quote: this language needs to be clarified so that it only applies to an appointed town clerk due to election requirements

decisions.decision: The town accountant will continue to be an appointment of the Selectmen (5-3(d)(3)).
decisions.quote: the town accountant will continue to be an appointment of the selectmen.

decisions.decision: Bob Ebersole will work with the Library and the Town Manager on language for 3-7 that meets the Library's wishes and the Town Manager's concerns, incorporating current state-law hiring practice.
decisions.quote: bob will work with the library and the town manager to get the language that meets what the library wants

decisions.decision: Bob Ebersole will gather information from the Secretary of State's office on changing the Town Clerk from elected to appointed.
decisions.quote: bob will gather information from the secretary of state

decisions.decision: Invite Carl and Phyllis Luck to an upcoming meeting to discuss the write-in candidate signature proposal.
decisions.quote: it was decided to invite them to an upcoming meeting to discuss the proposal.

decisions.decision: Invite a speaker in to discuss ranked choice voting.
decisions.quote: we will invite someone in to discuss the topic.

decisions.decision: No interest in revisiting term limits; the topic was dropped.
decisions.quote: there was no interest in revisiting term limits.

decisions.decision: Need to talk with the Town Moderator about the 4-1 Town Manager Search process, since the proposed changes make the committee an even numbered membership.
decisions.quote: need to talk with town moderator as the proposed changes make the committee an even numbered membership.

decisions.decision: Keep the proposed deleted language in 4-2(s) related to infrastructure maintenance, improvement and expansion, pending discussion with the town manager.
decisions.quote: 4-2 town manager powers and duties (s) keep the proposed deleted language
